name: Mile End Climbing Wall
summary: A charity-run climbing centre in an old pipe engineering works in Mile End Park, with bouldering and a Finnish sauna.
crowd: The centre says charities, groups, schools and recreational climbers all use it, and describes a relaxed, informal social atmosphere.

cost.notes: Climbing entry costs about £14.50 to £15.50 for adults and £10 to £11 for concessions, donation included, per the first-visit page.

age_policy: Under-14s can't climb or boulder unsupervised; 14-17s need experience and a competency test to boulder alone

evidence.quote: housed inside an old pipe engineering works which is located within Mile End Park
Mile End Climbing Wall is maintained by our own charity
There is extensive bouldering (low level climbing without ropes) at all levels
Forty five minutes of total relaxation at Mile End's very own Finnish sauna!
The centre is widely used by other development charities, groups, schools and recreational climbers.
Through our staff, regular customers and clubs, we have a relaxed and informal social atmosphere.
Mile End Climbing Wall Haverfield Road London E3 5BE
Juniors under 14 can’t be signed off to climb or boulder unsupervised.
Juniors between ages of 14 and 17 can boulder independently if they have relevant experience and can pass competency test
